mapper.sql: id, instance_id, calculation_version, calculation_type, calculation_status, input_data, output_data, error_message, execution_time, triggered_by, started_at, completed_at, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id, h.instance_id, h.calculation_version, h.calculation_type, h.calculation_status, h.input_data, h.output_data, h.error_message, h.execution_time, h.triggered_by, h.started_at, h.completed_at, h.created_at, i.instance_code, i.instance_name FROM soo_model_instance_calculation_history h LEFT JOIN soo_financial_model_instance i ON h.instance_id = i.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE h.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY h.started_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.id, h.instance_id, h.calculation_version, h.calculation_type, h.calculation_status, h.input_data, h.output_data, h.error_message, h.execution_time, h.triggered_by, h.started_at, h.completed_at, h.created_at, i.instance_code, i.instance_name FROM soo_model_instance_calculation_history h LEFT JOIN soo_financial_model_instance i ON h.instance_id = i.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE h.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY h.started_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCalculations, SUM(CASE WHEN calculation_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successfulCalculations, SUM(CASE WHEN calculation_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedCalculations, AVG(execution_time) as averageExecutionTime, MAX(started_at) as lastCalculationTime, SUM(CASE WHEN calculation_type = 'MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as manualCalculations, SUM(CASE WHEN calculation_type = 'AUTO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as autoCalculations, SUM(CASE WHEN calculation_type = 'SCHEDULED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as scheduledCalculations FROM soo_model_instance_calculation_history WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId}

SELECT h.id, h.instance_id, h.calculation_version, h.calculation_type, h.calculation_status, h.input_data, h.output_data, h.error_message, h.execution_time, h.triggered_by, h.started_at, h.completed_at, h.created_at, i.instance_code, i.instance_name FROM soo_model_instance_calculation_history h LEFT JOIN soo_financial_model_instance i ON h.instance_id = i.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE h.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND h.calculation_version = #{calculationVersion} ORDER BY h.started_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE soo_model_instance_calculation_history SET calculation_status = #{calculationStatus}, output_data = #{outputData}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, execution_time = #{executionTime}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
